# Geometry of Feeling

> Minimalist fine art prints where every piece begins with a human emotion and renders it through the mathematical equation that shares its shape.

## About
Geometry of Feeling is an art studio by David McCoy. Every piece is hand-coded in Python from real mathematical equations — no AI, no image generators, no prompts. Museum-quality giclée prints on Hahnemühle German Etching 310gsm. Three sizes from $45 with free shipping.

## Printing
All prints are museum-quality giclée on Hahnemühle German Etching 310gsm — a heavyweight, textured cotton rag paper. Sizes: 12×8" ($45), 24×16" ($95), 36×24" ($175). Free shipping on every order. Ships flat in rigid mailers.

## What Makes This Different
- Every piece is hand-coded in Python — not AI-generated, not prompted, not style-transferred
- Each series maps a specific emotion onto the mathematical system that behaves like it
- The equation is not a caption — it is the cause of the image
- Over 1,200 renders produced; fewer than 170 survived curation
